steps.text: Law, original law, had behind it, in synonymous form with vengeance, the same original need—the need for violence.
City-states made pledges to their people, and used sumptuous lives and stable surroundings to appease them—
To let their lifespans serve one man-made purpose, to tame their innate will to subjugate, to teach them to be at ease, to lead them to be weak.
Our Majesty is sage, perceptive.

A great many city-states will treat strength as a crime, will take deficient courage as a virtue, will regard fear of death as progress. Our Majesty will tear their last semblances from them, make them reflect, make them search themselves.
We, as a human race, have always had a kind of thirst flowing through our blood vessels; a thirst to loose our own life force by our actions.
Fairness is not by nature. Fairness is dependent on having the wisdom, the force of will to create it.
Our Majesty intends to recover all they need, all this the cities took away, and give it back to them.
New purpose will be declared. Our Majesty will rebuild their thought worn flat by daily life and boredom, and rouse the sanguine courage within them bound by deadened ethics for too long.
Violence runs our bodies through and through. If we don't allow it to germinate within ourselves, we will become resentful, insignificant and numb, and thus will incur our own destruction.
Those who fear habitually are despicable.
If one wants to be alive, they ought to be immersed in the heart of violence, see clearly how so much of ethics is a sham, understand the barren of our present world.
Only violence is real, able to be felt.

Not punishment, not rule, not the weighing of values and the decorum of appeasement. We will use our fists and weapons to tell them that we are alive, and that we ought to be alive. The right to life is reserved for the living.

I do not blame Our Majesty the Emperor for the punishment handed down on me. I showed contempt, ignorant of the times, for how he spoke all on his benevolent mind to the masses, for he was loathe for his people to all too quickly suffer the pain of violent change.
Even so, I cannot cease to tell the candid truth. I must constantly, continually praise Our Majesty's most profound insight. I can only shout my honesty. I cannot be silent.
The reality is, we do not want whatever justice, nor do we expect peace.
Only the shortsighted, rushing about their own interests, can wallow in peace.

What we want is to put to use the violence that surges in our veins, the nature of us aroused by the dawn of our own civilization, the origin of our dauntless struggle and victory. We want to make use of violence.
Dress it up any way to make our needs seem sensible, but that is irrelevant.
Should we need, we should seek directly. Leave the dressing up to the historians and the champions of morals. They only need justification, while our survival is more justified than any theory.
We want to injure people, defeat people, destroy people, and if Ursus reckons this disaster, then we should bring disaster to others, to people beyond Ursus.
If they do not stand strong, they should be eliminated. Some are fitter to survive than others, and fitter to succeed.
Weakness is evil. Strength is sublime. Our laws should be founded on the needs of the city's soundest. Our country should not serve the maggots, let alone nurture the innumerous ill.
May those I despise, those narrow-minded leisure-seeking subjects, be tried and found forever in the lake of blood. May Our Majesty lead Ursus to eternal prosperity.
—The last sermon of a heretical sovereign preacher as he walked the gallows, sentenced by the Emperor of Ursus to hang.
Chernobog Core City, Central District

steps.name: Reunion Infected
steps.text: Spies! Ursus spies!

steps.name: Reunion Infected
steps.text: They're right here! Tell everyone, they're right here!

steps.name: Reunion Infected
steps.text: Kill them, kill them! Hang them above the connecting floor, crush them against the top of Lungmen!

steps.name: Rosmontis Squadmember
steps.text: Let's retreat, Rosmontis. They've occupied the entire commercial plaza. This entire block's been sealed off by them now.

steps.name: Rosmontis Squadmember
steps.text: Rosmontis...!

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Let me do this. If we take a diversion, we'll be attacked by Reunion somewhere else.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Sarkaz...

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Hey, you! Eyes on that Caster... watch her! Don't let her try anything!

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Kill them all already! Quick!

steps.name: Reunion Infected
steps.text: Right! Right! Kill 'em, kill 'em all!

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: (Columbian-Victorian) You want to kill me?

steps.name: Reunion Infected
steps.text: You're all blind to it! You've all got Ursus chains on your necks!

steps.name: Rosmontis Squadmember
steps.text: Rosmontis, this isn't worth it! They've pretty much lost their minds! Let's move out of this block, find a different breach point!

steps.name: Reunion Infected
steps.text: Bowguns up! Bowguns up... blow it off! Blow her head off! You're like that bunny who was just here... you're like her!

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Amiya didn't go this way because she didn't want to do things like I do.

steps.name: Reunion Infected
steps.text: The hell are you all staring like that for? You're an Infected, you're an Infected! Why're you all staring at me like that? !

steps.name: Reunion Infected
steps.text: Collaborators? Trying to make it home? Like hell, hahah, like bleeding hell! Ursus can't defeat us! We've won! Won!

steps.name: Reunion Infected
steps.text: Fire! Fire at her, at her!

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: No point.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: No point. I don't want you to hurt me, so there's nothing you can do.

steps.name: Reunion Infected
steps.text: What the hell... what the hell?! Keep firing! Keep firing! Blow the whole place out!

steps.name: Reunion Infected
steps.text: Is that a wall? What kind of Arts... what the hell kind of—! The bolts are all breaking against it! They're breaking!

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Stop attacking those wall things, it's useless! Just looking at 'em tells you they won't budge! Call the Casters in!

steps.name: Reunion Infected
steps.text: The hell do you know?! We're attacking her face-on!

steps.name: Reunion Infected
steps.text: But before the arrows can reach her, and before the shrapnel can strike her face, they hit something! Some kind of invisible wall or something, whatever the hell! They just shatter! They can't get in!

steps.name: Reunion Infected
steps.text: Stupid goddamn Caster! We'll see how long you hold out... how much have you even got?! You can't keep this up for long, we'll see how long you hold out!

steps.name: Reunion Infected
steps.text: Why, why... can you not just hit her? She's not doing a damn thing! The hell are your ballistas, huh? The hell are your empowered crossbows?!

steps.name: Reunion Infected
steps.text: Bombard her, blow her to kingdom come! Blow her to smithereens! Blow her up like all those goddamned Ursus, and then make her tonight's stew!

steps.name: Rosmontis Squadmember
steps.text: This is the Rosmontis Squad, Amiya! We're through to you... talk her down! You need to talk her down!

steps.name: Rosmontis Squadmember
steps.text: Rosmontis, listen to the comms!

steps.name: Reunion Infected
steps.text: All you uniforms! Ahah! All you uniforms, we'll hang you, dry you on the power lines, let the rottenfeathers peck you apart!

steps.name: Reunion Infected
steps.text: We'll let you know! Know what you get for looking down on us!

steps.name: Reunion Infected
steps.text: Looking down on us, beating us, giving us those looks. Hahah—gack—we'll kill you all.

steps.name: Reunion Infected
steps.text: We'll throw you all into an engine, drr-dr-dr-dr-dr-dr-dr, and watch the minced meat come out, hahahahahah...!

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: What are you DOING? What are you prancing about for?! Don't expose your squad's position!

steps.name: Reunion Infected
steps.text: Don't waste your breath... goddamn devil! Hard-horned brute! What makes you think you can order ME?

steps.name: Reunion Infected
steps.text: You think you're Talulah? You think you're that undying goddamn beast? Whoopsie, he's already done for! Bang!

steps.name: Reunion Infected
steps.text: You'll all be done for! Us Ursus Infected'll... kill you! Kill the lot of you! You're all—
And the Sarkaz kicks the Infected straight out of the window.
The Infected howls, or perhaps it's more of a laugh, as he falls from the seventh floor to the ground, and is immediately obliterated by the ballistas.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: *Spit*.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Do it. Bring out the big guns. Kill 'em dead.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Amiya, can you hear me? We're taking the route we agreed. Out.

steps.name: Rosmontis Squadmember
steps.text: Rosmontis...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: What are the guerrillas' current movements?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: By our recon Operators' reports, the already-assembled guerrillas are currently in Central Main Street, openly attacking other Reunion guards.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: There's also a few small guerrilla squads opting to retreat instead, and they're scattering across every part of the city...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...I see. The guerrillas still have other obligations.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But our two teams are already too occupied to account for the situation anywhere else in the Core City.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The longer it takes to break through the blockade, the less time we'll have left.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: If the other anti-guerrilla Infected are kept pinned down by the guerrillas, we'll be able to reach the command tower much faster. We can't waste this opportunity.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'll leave controlling the overall situation to Raidian and Mantra's judgment. As for controlling the battlefield...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...I and Rosmontis both need more space to think.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: But. Rosmontis...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: After we rule out any ambush interference, we're still guaranteed other roundabout routes. But Rosmontis, I think, more or less can only choose to eliminate obstacles in front of her.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: More or less. That's how she's already done things.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Dr. Kal'tsit was on the mark. We're in one heck of a mess.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Reunion has already fallen apart, seeing as their infighting is killing them faster than the guerrilla attacks are.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: They usually have enough friction of their own, but then Patriot died, and that news blew up, and now everything's gone haywire.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: With all the devastation the whole way here, I'm hard-pressed to say they're that united anymore.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Notify the other team members to assemble. Have the Casters bring the drones back in. We're going to converge with Rosmontis.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Ah, Amiya.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Everything's dealt with here now.

steps.name: Rosmontis Squadmember
steps.text: Sorry, Amiya. There had to be a better way we could've done this.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: It's how I wanted to do it.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Negotiations falling through isn't a problem. The way they are, it's impossible to communicate.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: And they're doing bad things. If I left them alone, they'd just do even more bad things.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: An entire building... you took an entire building...

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Did I go too far?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: No, no. Just, I've just never been on a mission with you before. Seeing it for myself is a shocker.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: You really are the ace up Rhodes Island's sleeve. Our strongest war machine...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: (Amiya, did I say something wrong?)
The evening before the core city Operation Team's departure from the ship

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I won't allow it.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Dr. Kal'tsit. This time, I'm going to have to do it this way.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: We've gone over this question countless times before, Amiya.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Your Originium Arts expend your physical strength. This goes even as far as the physiological activity your metabolism requires.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Your life is... passing. You're not a machine, nor a ship's cannon. You cannot have your parts changed, nor can you be further processed.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I know.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: No. Maybe you still don't know.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: ...There'd be another memory from far too long ago. I'm not certain how much pressure it would bring about on your body.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Every simulation's result is leagues from anything ideal. I can rule out this choice.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Then how about this, Dr. Kal'tsit. Let me put it this way.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: This time, I need to do things this way. I'll be taking off one more ring.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Amiya, we are going over a form of violence. You have said as much to me. If you didn't want me to stop you here and now, then you wouldn't have asked me to swear it to you.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The Chairman and I cast these rings together. It was so that no-one who came after would easily walk that path again.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'm using them, Dr. Kal'tsit. I won't argue for weapons, and I would never say that any kind is better for its ability to kill faster.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: However, what Miss Theresa left to me was not the same thing at all.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Since the very beginning, perhaps they were never designed as weapons.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: They shouldn't be used to kill anyone... they never should. When they're used, what I think of is who I should save.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: This is the conclusion I've come to, after years of coexisting with them.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: ...Trusting a kind of weapon is not in any way a wise act.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: If you wish to use them as a surgical tool and not as a lethal weapon, then you must be in control of their blade.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: A blade is a blade to both the enemy and me, no matter how you use it. Its characteristics will not change.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Amiya... they will incise you.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Dr. Kal'tsit, I'm not afraid.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Wounds can heal.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: But they can leave behind scars. Scars that nobody can bear to look at.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...Mngh.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But I... I won't give up.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Originium has already changed my body in ways you know. Any further wounds... they'd be one or two wounds, and nothing more.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I am not a weapon.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Do you need me to bring up another hurtful example?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: —What case?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Who can prove that you and I are not a kind of weapon?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Who can come to define whether or not we are a kind of weapon?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Can weapons think? Are weapons that can think all the more fearsome? Are weapons with self-awareness automatically no longer a kind of weapon?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: No, Amiya. I disagree.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Even if I know—
You've already grown up.
I can't stop you.
Your decisions are yours to make.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Yes, Operator. You've misspoken.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Have you ever seen, um... such a...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...cute...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...weapon... before?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Um. No, not that I'm saying...

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Amiya... is cuter.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: S—Sorry! I can't think of... I can't think of another way to put it...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We're people. People, with a full complement of emotions.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: After this is over, find the chance to apologize to her, okay?

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Don't, don't, Amiya. It's okay.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Let's go. Together.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Ah, wait, Rosmontis... I think I might fall here!

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: I'm going to hold on tight to you. I can't let those guys, those Infected. I can't let them hurt you.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: A little slower... let's go a little slower, okay?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: (Maybe i shouldn't have said it like that. But...)
Central District

steps.name: Herdified Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Ngh, guh.

steps.name: Herdified Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: No. No come near.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I see it. Nobody with even normal eyesight could ignore this sort of phenomenon.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: —Do you still remember the special Infected you came across back in Lungmen?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The Infected Reunion boy who could induce mutation within other Infected's organs.

steps.name: Reunion Infected
steps.text: Mephisto's Herd?!

steps.name: Reunion Infected
steps.text: Even the devils...

steps.name: Herdified Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Don't. Don't, forward, any more, inside.

steps.name: Reunion Infected
steps.text: What are you...? We need to lay out our defenses forward! The rebels have almost fought their way here!

steps.name: Reunion Infected
steps.text: Goddamnit, Mephisto. What are you thinking? If we detoured, they wouldn't attack us...

steps.name: Herdified Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Nothing but, pain.

steps.name: Reunion Infected
steps.text: Wait a moment, wait a moment! What are you doing?!

steps.name: Herdified Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Pain.

steps.name: Reunion Infected
steps.text: Let go of me! Let go!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: All units, we're moving back. Keep cover.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: We'll change entranceways after that. Something bad's happened already.
